state: Existing time.Entry data belongs to Employee; hourly money is captured rather than reread from Project. The authored correct operation currently authorizes project_manager, requires can_work(actor,entry.project.location), rejected/approved/exported state, increasing start/end and nonempty trimmed reason, and appends Entry plus Correction. It never retires the old active interval or settles exported charges. Authored bill grants project_manager and demands work permission at the project location, approved billable time, a present customer and a positive minor amount. The real invoice boundary is BillingV1: charge(value:Charge)->OperationOutcome, cancel(source:text,reason:text)->OperationOutcome, refund(source:text,amount:money,reason:text)->OperationOutcome, reconcile(source:text)->Settlement?, with settled {value:Settlement}. Its snapshot fields are source, invoice, revision, amount, collected, refunded, collection_pending, refund_pending, state, recorded_at. cancel permanently reserves its source against recharging and stops new collections; it cannot release collected money, reporting unavailable instead, and released needs void with no remaining funds. Refund handling excludes unresolved attempts and sometimes needs evidenced finance action for split/external receipts. Delivery fulfillment is separate from financial settlement. Required common behavior: keep original evidence and manager identity/reason, admit replacement export only when the old source is safely dealt with, stay inside the single local D1 transaction boundary and label all generated imports unimplemented. Proposed period handling stores a fixed Employee interval plus all completed draft rows inside it; one transaction freezes the group, a currently authorized manager can decide it, and an attributed rejection or withdrawal restores draft rows. Time creation/change/correction must all reject half-open overlaps unless a project_manager records an exception. The deliverables describe source and JavaScript targets without building their runtime.

time_correction.instructions: Judge the alternatives against financial integrity, attributed review history and compact workable declarations at this actual service boundary; a favorable classification is not a correctness guarantee.

criteria.A: Use full financial replacement: permanently cancel the original reference, read settled balances, refund any retained amount through an explicit manager action and verify release before charging the corrected reference. It unifies increases/decreases and preserves evidence, while causing refund/recollection costs and potentially waiting on finance.
criteria.B: Use incremental financial adjustment: maintain the original obligation, bill positive differences under distinct references or return negative differences by partial refund, and verify each outcome. It can reduce cash movement, but successive corrections need cumulative revision/delta accounting plus independent source and interval retirement rules.
